blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 2.3
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 2.3

blocks.text: विद्याशरीरसत्ता मन्त्ररहस्यम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] विद्याशरीरसत्ता मन्त्ररहस्यम्

blocks.text: Vidyāśarīrasattā mantrarahasyam.
blocks.directed: Vidyāśarīrasattā mantrarahasyam.

blocks.text: The conscious being underlying the knowledge-formed body of mantra is its secret.
blocks.directed: The conscious being underlying the knowledge-formed body of mantra is its secret.

blocks.text: The Secret of Mantra Is That You’ve Been Worshipping the Alphabet Without Knowing Its Mother.
blocks.directed: The Secret of Mantra Is That You’ve Been Worshipping the Alphabet Without Knowing Its Mother.

blocks.text: Oh, now we’re getting somewhere.
blocks.directed: Oh, now we’re getting somewhere.

blocks.text: Vidya.
blocks.directed: Vidya.

blocks.text: Śarīra.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Śarīra.

blocks.text: Sattā.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Sattā.

blocks.text: Mantra.
blocks.directed: Mantra.

blocks.text: Rahasya.
blocks.directed: Rahasya.

blocks.text: Let’s get the Sanskrit properly unpacked, because this is an absolutely gorgeous compound.
blocks.directed: Let’s get the Sanskrit properly unpacked, because this is an absolutely gorgeous compound.

blocks.text: Vidyā — knowledge, particularly liberating or pure knowledge in this context.
blocks.directed: Vidyā — knowledge, particularly liberating or pure knowledge in this context.

blocks.text: Śarīra — body, embodiment.
blocks.directed: Śarīra — body, embodiment.

blocks.text: Sattā — existence, being.
blocks.directed: Sattā — existence, being.

blocks.text: Mantra — sacred formula.
blocks.directed: Mantra — sacred formula.

blocks.text: Rahasya — secret, mystery, hidden essence.
blocks.directed: Rahasya — secret, mystery, hidden essence.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja interprets vidyāśarīra as that whose essential body consists of supreme nondual knowledge.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja interprets vidyāśarīra as that whose essential body consists of supreme nondual knowledge.

blocks.text: And the sattā, the conscious being of that knowledge-body, is the luminous power of pure I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: And the sattā, the conscious being of that knowledge-body, is the luminous power of pure I-consciousness.

blocks.text: This is the secret of mantra.
blocks.directed: This is the secret of mantra.

blocks.text: Now, an ordinary person sees a written mantra.
blocks.directed: Now, an ordinary person sees a written mantra.

blocks.text: A series of letters.
blocks.directed: A series of letters.

blocks.text: Perhaps:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Perhaps:

blocks.text: न मः शि वा य
blocks.directed: [slowly] न मः शि वा य

blocks.text: Na — maḥ — śi — vā — ya.
blocks.directed: Na — maḥ — śi — vā — ya.

blocks.text: Five syllables in the traditional namaḥ śivāya formulation, with namaḥ sandhi and pronunciation treated according to the chant.
blocks.directed: Five syllables in the traditional namaḥ śivāya formulation, with namaḥ sandhi and pronunciation treated according to the chant.

blocks.text: There’s a sequence.
blocks.directed: There’s a sequence.

blocks.text: The sounds occur one after another.
blocks.directed: The sounds occur one after another.

blocks.text: Your mouth moves.
blocks.directed: Your mouth moves.

blocks.text: Your tongue changes position.
blocks.directed: Your tongue changes position.

blocks.text: The sound resonates.
blocks.directed: The sound resonates.

blocks.text: And you might naturally conclude that the mantra consists fundamentally of those audible units.
blocks.directed: And you might naturally conclude that the mantra consists fundamentally of those audible units.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja wants us to look deeper.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja wants us to look deeper.

blocks.text: The syllables belong to Mātṛkā, the divine matrix of phonemes.
blocks.directed: The syllables belong to Mātṛkā, the divine matrix of phonemes.

blocks.text: And the phonemes are expressions of Śakti.
blocks.directed: And the phonemes are expressions of Śakti.

blocks.text: So what ultimately gives the mantra its sacred identity?
blocks.directed: So what ultimately gives the mantra its sacred identity?

blocks.text: Not merely its acoustic properties.
blocks.directed: Not merely its acoustic properties.

blocks.text: Not merely a collection of letters.
blocks.directed: Not merely a collection of letters.

blocks.text: But the conscious power manifested through them.
blocks.directed: But the conscious power manifested through them.

blocks.text: This is where the tantric philosophy of speech becomes absolutely outrageous.
blocks.directed: This is where the tantric philosophy of speech becomes absolutely outrageous.

blocks.text: Because language isn’t treated simply as a human invention for labelling pre-existing things.
blocks.directed: Because language isn’t treated simply as a human invention for labelling pre-existing things.

blocks.text: It is understood through a cosmological theory in which the unfolding of speech corresponds to the unfolding of manifestation.
blocks.directed: It is understood through a cosmological theory in which the unfolding of speech corresponds to the unfolding of manifestation.

blocks.text: The phenomenal world appears articulated through innumerable distinctions.
blocks.directed: The phenomenal world appears articulated through innumerable distinctions.

blocks.text: And speech expresses, organises, and, within this tantric metaphysics, participates in the very manifestation of those distinctions.
blocks.directed: And speech expresses, organises, and, within this tantric metaphysics, participates in the very manifestation of those distinctions.

blocks.text: Now, before everyone starts claiming Sanskrit is physically generating hydrogen atoms, we need to be precise.
blocks.directed: Now, before everyone starts claiming Sanskrit is physically generating hydrogen atoms, we need to be precise.

blocks.text: This is a metaphysical doctrine of consciousness and manifestation.
blocks.directed: This is a metaphysical doctrine of consciousness and manifestation.

blocks.text: It isn’t a laboratory demonstration that pronouncing a vowel creates an element of the periodic table.
blocks.directed: It isn’t a laboratory demonstration that pronouncing a vowel creates an element of the periodic table.

blocks.text: But within the Trika system, there is a deep relationship between the powers of conscious manifestation and the articulated structure of language.
blocks.directed: But within the Trika system, there is a deep relationship between the powers of conscious manifestation and the articulated structure of language.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja supports his explanation with an astonishing passage from the Tantrasadbhāva.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja supports his explanation with an astonishing passage from the Tantrasadbhāva.

blocks.text: He describes Śakti in her sleeping, coiled condition.
blocks.directed: He describes Śakti in her sleeping, coiled condition.

blocks.text: The potential universe lies within her.
blocks.directed: The potential universe lies within her.

blocks.text: The powers associated with bindu, the divine point, and visarga, emission, participate in the manifestation of the phonemes.
blocks.directed: The powers associated with bindu, the divine point, and visarga, emission, participate in the manifestation of the phonemes.

blocks.text: The letters appear through increasingly differentiated powers.
blocks.directed: The letters appear through increasingly differentiated powers.

blocks.text: And the many forms of speech and manifestation arise from the one Śakti.
blocks.directed: And the many forms of speech and manifestation arise from the one Śakti.

blocks.text: This passage involves Kuṇḍalinī, subtle sound, the arrangement of letters, divine powers, and the emergence of multiplicity.
blocks.directed: This passage involves Kuṇḍalinī, subtle sound, the arrangement of letters, divine powers, and the emergence of multiplicity.

blocks.text: It’s not a casual metaphor casually added by Kṣemarāja.
blocks.directed: It’s not a casual metaphor casually added by Kṣemarāja.

blocks.text: It’s part of the actual scriptural material he deploys to explain the secret of mantra. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: It’s part of the actual scriptural material he deploys to explain the secret of mantra. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: Think of a piece of music.
blocks.directed: Think of a piece of music.

blocks.text: You can analyse its individual notes.
blocks.directed: You can analyse its individual notes.

blocks.text: Their frequencies.
blocks.directed: Their frequencies.

blocks.text: Their duration.
blocks.directed: Their duration.

blocks.text: Their order.
blocks.directed: Their order.

blocks.text: You can write every note onto a page.
blocks.directed: You can write every note onto a page.

blocks.text: But the living experience of the music is not simply a pile of isolated acoustic measurements.
blocks.directed: But the living experience of the music is not simply a pile of isolated acoustic measurements.

blocks.text: Now imagine a much more radical theory.
blocks.directed: Now imagine a much more radical theory.

blocks.text: The very possibility of articulation, intelligibility, experience and manifestation belongs to one conscious power.
blocks.directed: The very possibility of articulation, intelligibility, experience and manifestation belongs to one conscious power.

blocks.text: The notes are expressions of that power.
blocks.directed: The notes are expressions of that power.

blocks.text: The listener is an expression of that power.
blocks.directed: The listener is an expression of that power.

blocks.text: The experienced unity of the music is also an expression of that power.
blocks.directed: The experienced unity of the music is also an expression of that power.

blocks.text: That’s the kind of nondual move Kṣemarāja is making with mantra.
blocks.directed: That’s the kind of nondual move Kṣemarāja is making with mantra.

blocks.text: And the final secret?
blocks.directed: And the final secret?

blocks.text: The living divine power is not separate from the consciousness through which the mantra is contemplated.
blocks.directed: The living divine power is not separate from the consciousness through which the mantra is contemplated.

blocks.text: This is why merely knowing the correct syllables is insufficient for the highest recognition.
blocks.directed: This is why merely knowing the correct syllables is insufficient for the highest recognition.

blocks.text: You can possess the letters and remain ignorant of their source.
blocks.directed: You can possess the letters and remain ignorant of their source.

blocks.text: You can pronounce the mantra perfectly and still approach Śiva as an entirely separate deity.
blocks.directed: You can pronounce the mantra perfectly and still approach Śiva as an entirely separate deity.

blocks.text: You can become the world’s leading expert in the phonology of Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya and spend your entire life wondering whether you’ve finally reached the divine.
blocks.directed: You can become the world’s leading expert in the phonology of Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya and spend your entire life wondering whether you’ve finally reached the divine.

blocks.text: While, according to the doctrine, the conscious power making the entire investigation possible is precisely what you’re seeking.
blocks.directed: While, according to the doctrine, the conscious power making the entire investigation possible is precisely what you’re seeking.

blocks.text: It’s like studying the chemical composition of ink on a love letter while ignoring the love letter.
blocks.directed: It’s like studying the chemical composition of ink on a love letter while ignoring the love letter.

blocks.text: Very accurate chemistry.
blocks.directed: Very accurate chemistry.

blocks.text: Very unfortunate relationship.
blocks.directed: Very unfortunate relationship.

blocks.text: The philosophical point: For Kṣemarāja, the inner secret of mantra is Śakti as self-aware, universal consciousness, not the mere external sequence of phonemes. The phonemes remain significant, but their highest efficacy depends upon recognition of that conscious source.
blocks.directed: The philosophical point: For Kṣemarāja, the inner secret of mantra is Śakti as self-aware, universal consciousness, not the mere external sequence of phonemes. The phonemes remain significant, but their highest efficacy depends upon recognition of that conscious source.

blocks.text: And now, having explained the extraordinary secret of mantra, Vasugupta offers a warning.
blocks.directed: And now, having explained the extraordinary secret of mantra, Vasugupta offers a warning.

blocks.text: Because apparently you can get all the way into advanced tantric practice, encounter unusual experiences, and still completely miss the point.
blocks.directed: Because apparently you can get all the way into advanced tantric practice, encounter unusual experiences, and still completely miss the point.

blocks.text: Which is deeply embarrassing.
blocks.directed: Which is deeply embarrassing.
